items.summary: fix(storage): publish conversation and plugin-state mutation receipts (#167731) Publish committed conversation and plugin-state row facts through the existing SQLite postcommit and worker receipt owners, including touches, expiry, eviction, deletion, and clear. Preserve unknown settlement, supersession, overflow handling, and existing final-authority guards. Keep main's worker-backed ClickClack store and direct persisted-target validation, with stale-route regression coverage. No stored schema, retention, permission, or released SDK contract changes. The measured first-turn +18 statements (+0.68%) is explicitly accepted because these receipts enable the follow-up removal of freshness probes. Validation: 43 focused integration/import tests plus wrapper inventory; core and extension production/test types; zero import cycles; changed-file formatting; exact-head published 2026.9.8 update cell (19 phases), preserving durable data and clearing incognito data. Landing uses the authorized inherited-CI exception: two unchanged restart-recovery fixture cases close a projection reader while holding a writer, triggering main's development cleanup guard from #167662. All other selected CI categories and independent security gates passed. ClawSweeper completed the final head with no findings. Head-pinned REST squash follows native worktree/lock contention exceeding 30 minutes.

items.title: 當威脅情報只剩大量數據，企業該相信什麼？
items.summary: 生成式AI降低了偵察、釣魚郵件撰寫及部分程式開發工作的門檻，使攻擊者得以更快、更大量地展開行動，企業導入模型、資料集、套件與AI工具後，擴大了軟體及AI供應鏈的風險。 這兩股力量交織之下，企業面對的不再是單一威脅，而是速度與範圍同時擴張的攻擊環境。卡巴斯基臺灣技術總監謝長軒指出，AI能大量產出資料，決定防禦成敗的關鍵，不是誰握有最多預警訊號，而是誰能把海量資料轉化為可以立即行動的情報。 他認為，好的威脅情報必須同時具備來源可信、時間有效、脈絡相關、信心度清楚與可執行等條件，AI能加快前段處理，專家則負責高風險判斷與情境分析，兩者缺一不可。

items.title: 日本IDC Frontier雲端遭勒索軟體攻擊，波及495家客戶、部分系統靠備份重建
items.summary: 日本雲端服務業者IDC Frontier旗下IDCF Cloud於10月7日遭勒索軟體攻擊，造成部分虛擬伺服器停機且無法重新啟動，影響495個企業及地方政府客戶。IDC Frontier在8日指出，受影響服務區的客戶資料恐難以取出或復原，目前研判只能透過客戶自行保存的備份重建系統。
